messages:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGE fired: quota-mapper anomaly for service=redwood-api, symptom=high-429s, scope=tenant-group t-337,t-412, auto-escalation=enabled, pd_incident=PD-98765 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: INCIDENT PD-98765 created and assigned to schedule 'sre-oncall'. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-98765
Maya (sre-oncall): acked in PD. I'm on it. first look: seeing sustained 429 spikes from the rate-limiter layer for a subset of tenants.
Kevin (sre): I saw the page. tagging in. any recent deploys to quota-mapper or quota-mapper-config?
Maya (sre-oncall): ops-deploy authored a mapping change 12m ago: config commit 7a3f2c -> added new tag rule for t-337 family. Could be bad wildcard.
Jen (ops-lead): confirming deploys: yes, mapping-service rolled at +11m, can share rollout id: rollout/2026-03-14-ops-73
Maya (sre-oncall): quick health checks: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=quota-mapper` shows 3/3 ready but logs are noisy. running log grep:
```
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/quota-mapper --since=15m | grep "t-337" | tail -n 40
# lots of "quota not found for tag: t-337-wildcard" and 429 responses upstream
```
Kevin (sre): interesting — quota-mapper returning no-match falls back to default quota which is very strict -> 429 storm. Did the config omit the tag prefix?
Maya (sre-oncall): looks like the rule uses `tenant_group: t-33*` instead of `t-337*` so it's not matching. human typo.
incident-bot: Pager suppressed count: 3 older identical AUTOPAGE events suppressed in last 8m due to ack+suppression TTL. autopage suppression prevented repeated PD pages — we still have active incident.
Maya (sre-oncall): hmm suppression prevented repeated alerts but allowed incident to persist. we need to fix mapping quickly.
Arya (eng-platform): I'm prepped to push hotfix to mapping service. small patch to add explicit `t-337` rule and prioritize exact match. prepping PR now.
Jen (ops-lead): mitigation plan: 1) rollback mapping commit OR 2) patch mapping to add explicit rule. 3) restart quota-mapper pods to pick up change (if rollback/patch applied). 4) temporary bypass: add permissive default for affected tenant-group in routing layer.
Kevin (sre): prioritize minimal blast radius. let's PATCH with explicit rule first, then verify metrics, rollback only if patch fails.
Maya (sre-oncall): assigning tasks: Arya -> patch + deploy, Jen -> prepare bypass rule and CS notify, Kevin -> monitor and ready for pod restart.
Arya (eng-platform): deploying patch now (hotfix branch). command:
```
# apply new mapping entry for exact t-337
kubectl -n prod exec -it job/mapping-updater -- /bin/sh -c "apply-mapping --add 'tenant=t-337,quota=standard'"
```
Arya (eng-platform): patch applied, pushing rollout. watching logs.
Maya (sre-oncall): logs show mapping match starting to occur, first matched entries at +26s.
Jen (ops-lead): enabling bypass rule (low-risk): `route-override add --tenant-group t-337 --default-quota permissive --ttl 10m`
Jen (ops-lead): bypass in place. routing check: `curl -s https://routing.prod/health?tenant=t-337 | jq .quota` returns "permissive"
incident-bot: AUTOPAGE EVENT: duplicate pages suppressed previously; new event detected but PD already has PD-98765 open, no new page created.
pagerduty: PD-98765 auto-escalation triggered to schedule 'sre-lead' after 15m unacknowledged by lead. (escalation step: Kevin -> Maya -> SRE-lead).
Maya (sre-oncall): metrics update: 429 rate for service dropped from ~18% -> 1.1% after patch + bypass (observed over 1m window). still watching for tail latencies.
Kevin (sre): good. rolling restart of quota-mapper to clear stale state:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/quota-mapper
kubectl -n prod wait --for=condition=available deployment/quota-mapper --timeout=120s
```
Kevin (sre): restart completed, pods back to 3/3 ready. logs clean for matched tenants.
Maya (sre-oncall): customer impact: CS reports 4 customers in t-337/t-412 saw 429s for ~8-12m. will need postmortem and CS outreach.
Luis (cs): drafting customer message: "We experienced a transient rate limiting event affecting a subset of tenants between 14:05–14:17 UTC. Root cause: configuration typo in quota mapping. Services have been restored; we're following up with next steps and compensation if impacted." Any edits?
Jen (ops-lead): add note: we enabled temporary permissive routing to reduce impact and reverted the problematic rule in mapping-service.
Luis (cs): added that. Will send to affected accounts in ~10m once incident reverted to monitoring.
Maya (sre-oncall): can we capture the problematic commit and tag for postmortem? commit id 7a3f2c, author ops-deploy. saving snapshot.
incident-bot: Note: suppression behavior: the autopager suppression TTL is 300s and suppressed 3 duplicate pages. team discussion needed whether suppression should be relaxed for config-change-origin events.
Kevin (sre): agree — create follow-up action: review autopager suppression rules and add rule to bypass suppression for config-change-sourced events.
Arya (eng-platform): filed task: PLAT-4997 "autopager: bypass suppression for mapping-service deploys" and linked to PD-98765.
Maya (sre-oncall): monitoring: 429s at 0.6% over 5m, error budget ok. switching incident to status: mitigated -> monitoring.
pagerduty: PD-98765 status changed: acknowledged -> mitigated.
Jen (ops-lead): preparing runbook notes: reproducible steps, commands used, and customer list attached. I'll drop runbook draft in #postmortems.
Luis (cs): outbound sent to affected customers. copied legal + sales.
Maya (sre-oncall): final checks: ensure mapping repo has guardrails (unit tests to catch wildcard typos). tagging research: add validation to mapping uploader.
Kevin (sre): +1. also recommend we add an alert on mismatch-rate: number of "no match" events from quota-mapper exceeding threshold per minute.
Maya (sre-oncall): thanks team. closing active mitigation. will leave thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
Arya (eng-platform): quick note — we need to review autopager suppression config before closing PD fully. filed.
incident-bot: PD-98765 remains open for postmortem until owner closes.
